# protonmail-mcp-server

> A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for reading and organizing Proton Mail through Proton Bridge. It cannot send email and cannot permanently delete email.

## Tools

- proton_list_folders: List all mailbox folders with message and unread counts
- proton_list_emails: List emails in a folder with pagination, returns summaries (subject, from, date, snippet)
- proton_search_emails: Search emails by sender, recipient, subject, body text, date range, read/flagged status
- proton_get_email: Read a single email's full content by IMAP UID
- proton_read_attachment: Extract text from one attachment (PDF, text, HTML); ask the user first
- proton_move_emails: Move emails between INBOX, Archive and Folders/* (max 50 per call)
- proton_trash_emails: Move emails to Trash, recoverable; there is no permanent delete (max 50 per call)
- proton_label_emails: Apply an existing label (Labels/*) without moving the email
- proton_unlabel_emails: Remove a label without moving or deleting the email

## Requirements

- Paid Proton Mail plan (Proton Bridge is not available on the free plan)
- Proton Bridge running locally (provides IMAP access)
- Node.js 22.13+

## Privacy

- No sending and no permanent deletion; never touches emails in Trash or Spam
- No disk caching: email content is never written to the filesystem
- Localhost-only: connects to Proton Bridge on 127.0.0.1 by default
- No credential logging: Bridge password is never logged or exposed
